scope: Retrieval evidence only; not end-to-end answer accuracy or an external benchmark.

results.name: accented evidence competes with an unaccented distractor
results.query: qual minha restricao alimentar sobre camarao?
expected: Minha restrição alimentar é não comer camarão.
returned: Minha restrição alimentar é não comer camarão.

results.name: decomposed accents reach the same evidence
results.query: qual minha restrição alimentar sobre camarão?
expected: Minha restrição alimentar é não comer camarão.
returned: Minha restrição alimentar é não comer camarão.

results.name: a correction keeps both pieces of evidence available
results.query: How did my editor change from January to March?
expected: My editor was Neovim in January.
My editor is now Emacs since March.
returned: My editor was Neovim in January.
My editor is now Emacs since March.

results.name: a negation survives beside its earlier value
results.query: What did I say about coffee and sugar?
expected: I drink coffee with sugar.
I no longer drink coffee with sugar.
returned: I drink coffee with sugar.
I no longer drink coffee with sugar.

results.name: two constraints can be recalled together
results.query: What are my keyboard constraints?
expected: My keyboard must support Colemak.
My keyboard must have split halves.
returned: My keyboard must support Colemak.
My keyboard must have split halves.

results.name: an unknown personal fact shares a topic with known facts
results.query: When is my sister Ana birthday?
returned: My sister Ana plays tennis.
My sister Ana lives in Recife.

results.name: an unknown project value shares its entity with known values
results.query: What is the Atlas deployment password?
returned: The Atlas deployment uses Docker.
The Atlas deployment runs on Friday.

results.name: a paraphrase uses a different vocabulary
results.query: What is my hobby?
expected: I play guitar every weekend.

results.name: a question switches languages
results.query: Which keyboard layout do I use?
expected: Meu teclado é um Corne com layout Colemak.
returned: Meu teclado é um Corne com layout Colemak.

results.name: history supplies a decision that was never saved as a fact
results.query: What did we choose for the archive?
expected: We chose SQLite for the archive.
returned: We chose SQLite for the archive.

results.name: history joins evidence from different sessions and gateways
results.query: What does the archive require?
expected: The archive requires offline access.
The archive requires encrypted backups.
returned: The archive requires encrypted backups.
The archive requires offline access.

results.name: an unrelated question has no evidence
results.query: What is the capital of Iceland?
